tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Slide and page background. Dark: the editor's night indigo. Light: paper for documents and light slides.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, chart tracks, inline code chips and table stripes, on surface.

tokens.name: surface-focus
tokens.usage: Fill of the one focused card on a slide, always paired with a focus border.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: The dark cover band on a document's first page. Stays dark in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules, card borders and table row dividers.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and emphasized text on surface and surface-raised; body text in documents. Light value is the old night ground used as ink.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text on slides, on surface and surface-raised. The editor's soft gray, never pure white.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Labels, owners, metadata and chart values, on surface and surface-raised. From the editor's title bar.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Slide footers and page numbers, on surface. Lowest-emphasis text that still meets 4.5:1.

tokens.name: band-ink
tokens.usage: Title text on band.

tokens.name: band-text
tokens.usage: Body and metadata text on band.

tokens.name: band-mist
tokens.usage: Labels on band.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary accent: emphasized words in titles, document headings, recommended tags. On surface.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Chart bars and other filled marks. Not for text in the light theme (3.9:1).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Secondary accent: bullet ticks, document section labels, costs, the done status. On surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in documents. Deeper than focus in light so a link never reads as a focus outline.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The editor's focusBorder. Lines and outlines only: the one focused element per slide, the short rule before labels, the band's bottom edge. Never text, never a fill. 3.6:1 on dark surface, 4.9:1 on light.

tokens.name: focus-dim
tokens.usage: The hairline frame inset on every slide. Decorative.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Watch this: at-risk status, slipping items, document notes. Text or marks on surface.

tokens.name: rose-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a note callout, behind rose and ink.

tokens.name: scarlet
tokens.usage: Problem values as text: the outlier number, a risk label. At most once per slide, never in a headline.

tokens.name: scarlet-fill
tokens.usage: Problem marks as fills: the outlier bar, the risk callout's edge. Fills only on dark (2.8:1).

tokens.name: scarlet-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a risk callout, behind scarlet and ink.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code block background. Code stays dark in both themes.

tokens.name: code-text
tokens.usage: Default code text on code-bg.

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords (template, struct, auto, return) on code-bg.

tokens.name: syntax-type
tokens.usage: Types and classes on code-bg.

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: Strings on code-bg. Ember: the only place it appears.

tokens.name: syntax-number
tokens.usage: Numeric literals on code-bg.

tokens.name: syntax-function
tokens.usage: Function names on code-bg.

tokens.name: syntax-variable
tokens.usage: Variables and members on code-bg.

tokens.name: syntax-comment
tokens.usage: Comments on code-bg.

styles.name: slide-cover
styles.usage: Cover title, 6% of slide width. Weight 700 and no tracking so PowerPoint and Google Slides render it exactly as the browser does.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: Content slide title, 3.6% of slide width. Weight 700 and no tracking so it wraps the same way in PowerPoint and Google Slides.
styles.sample: One ingestion path for every data source

styles.name: slide-body
styles.usage: Bullets and paragraphs, 1.75% of slide width.
styles.sample: Idempotent writes, so retries are safe by default

styles.name: slide-label
styles.usage: Kicker above a title, uppercase, 1.5% of slide width. Single line only: Google Slides drops the tracking, which only makes it narrower.

styles.name: slide-code
styles.usage: Code on slides, 1.55% of slide width.

styles.name: doc-title
styles.usage: Document title on the cover band. Weight 700, no tracking: Word and Google Docs only know regular and bold.

styles.name: doc-heading
styles.usage: Section headings, in accent. Weight 700, no tracking.

styles.name: doc-lede
styles.usage: First paragraph of a section when it carries the point.
styles.sample: The migration runs one service at a time.

styles.name: doc-body
styles.sample: Today, each data source has its own parser and retry logic.

styles.name: doc-label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels, table headers, callout labels. Single line only; the tracking is dropped in Google Docs and Slides.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: label to title, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a component.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Callout padding, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gaps between document blocks; code block padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards and slides.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Document body padding top.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Document side padding and band padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Document pages, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Code blocks, callouts, chips, chart bars.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Slides and cards.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Rules, card borders, the slide frame.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: The focus outline and the band's bottom edge, in focus.

tokens.name: stroke-edge
tokens.usage: Callout left edges, in rose or scarlet-fill.
